item.title: Morocco Overhauls the Legal Profession, Makes Impersonating a Lawyer a Prison Offense
item.description: A new law rewrites the rules for who can practice law in Morocco and criminalizes impersonating a lawyer, alongside a judicial appointments fix and a Settat water project.
